jobs.description:
For the strengthening of our team, we are looking for a truck driver with a Category C driving licence to operate our emulsion truck.

You will depart from our depot in Oostende and drive to various construction sites throughout West Flanders. In addition to the transport, you will also be responsible for the correct application and processing of the emulsion on site, meaning you will be active both behind the wheel and on the construction site.

Your responsibilities:

  • You transport emulsion from our depot in Oostende to various construction sites throughout West Flanders;
  • You are responsible for the correct and safe loading and unloading of emulsion;
  • You operate the emulsion truck's equipment and ensure the correct application of the emulsion;
  • You work both with machinery and manually during the processing of emulsion on site.



What do we expect from you?

  • You have a valid Category C driving licence.
  • Code 95 is NOT required.
  • You have good technical insight and are willing to learn how the emulsion truck operates and how emulsion is processed on site.
  • You speak and understand sufficient Dutch or English to communicate safely and smoothly with your colleagues.

Would you like to help build high-quality roads throughout West Flanders? Then we would love to hear from you!

Antwerp Convention Bureau (ACB – www.antwerpconventionbureau.be) focuses on promoting the city of Antwerp as a premium destination for meetings, incentives, conferences, exhibitions, and events (MICE). Their brand promise is ‘The city is your venue’. Antwerp Convention Bureau highlights the diverse range of conference facilities in Antwerp and builds strong local expertise to support conference organizers and attendees in hosting conferences and business activities within the city.
The goal is to use a comprehensive marketing strategy and a proactive approach to attract international B-2-B events for associations or the industry that generate a positive impact on the residents, entrepreneurs, and visitors of the city of Antwerp. These events reinforce local and regional policies because they are linked to strong economic clusters, knowledge institutions, or centers of expertise.
In order to expand its organization and network, Antwerp Convention Bureau is actively seeking a new Managing Director.

Jobomschrijving

As Managing Director, you are the driving force behind the long-term strategy and financial performance of the organisation. Taking full P&L responsibility, you safeguard the financial health and ensure a maximum return on investment for the allocated budgets. You build on the current momentum by prioritizing the structuring of the organisation, implementing clear processes, and inspiring the internal team. Furthermore, you act as the primary local and international ambassador who proudly carries the bureau's successes to the city and its stakeholders, further shaping its vision within the meeting and convention (MICE) industry. 
As Managing Director, you will be responsible for:

• Managing human and financial resources efficiently within the allocated budgets while meeting the city's KPI’s.
• Coaching, motivating, and guiding the team to perform at their maximum potential, ensuring clear roles and responsibilities.
• Maintaining a strong and proactive network of relationships with the financing government, local stakeholders, and various players within the industry.
• Reporting on operations and milestones to the Executive Board.
• Representing ACB with strong communication skills. Expanding the (inter)national network within the highly competitive meeting industry. Simultaneously, you showcase local successes and act as the public face of the organization fostering the local public relations (PR), translating achievements into pride for the city and local stakeholders. 
• Leading the day-to-day management and further development of the organisation in line with the long-term strategy, ensuring the implementation of clear procedures, best practices, and an optimal organisational structure.

You are first and foremost an organisation builder and a true people manager who provides your team with direction, clarity, and structure. Additionally, you are a business-minded networker who effortlessly represents the organisation and inspires others during presentations and networking events. You possess a strategic approach paired with innovative thinking, and you show great diplomatic sensitivity towards the interests of local stakeholders.
Additionally, you possess:

• A Master’s degree (or equivalent working and thinking level), coupled with substantial experience in setting up, structuring, and leading a solid organisation at a senior management level.
• Strong PR skills and a proven track record of local stakeholder management, successfully communicating results to government, partners, ambassadors, the team and other stakeholders.
• A background in the (inter)national hospitality industry, or experience as a senior business marketing and sales professional within a highly competitive international sector. Experience within the MICE sector is considered a strong asset, though leadership skills are prioritized.
• A strict commitment to being based in Antwerp alongside a readiness to travel internationally.
• Excellent oral and written communication skills in both Dutch and English.

jobs.occupation: Extra income as CE truck driver - part-time or weekend work
jobs.description:
Are you living in Belgium and looking for some extra income? Do you have a valid CE driving licence and experience as a CE truck driver, HGV driver or lorry driver? And do you want a flexible way to earn extra money alongside your current job or during your free days?

For a well-established transport company in Oostkamp, specialized in frozen food transport and temperature-controlled logistics, we're looking for reliable CE truck drivers who want to work one or more days per week. You decide when you're available: weekdays, Saturdays, or both. And the best part is that Dutch isn't required; you can also apply if you only speak English!

Your job

As a CE driver, you will deliver frozen food products to supermarkets, distribution centres, and business customers across Belgium and neighbouring countries.

Your drives:

• Transport of frozen goods

• National deliveries throughout Belgium, but also to the Netherlands, Luxembourg, France and Germany

• Up to 15h/day on the road (waiting and resting times included)

• Varying number of stops: between 5 to 15 stops/day

Routes are prepared in advance and your trailer is already loaded, connected, fuelled, and ready to go before departure.

You'll almost never have to sleep in your truck, except for some for very exceptional cases when there's no other possibility.

We're looking for a driver who:

• Has a valid CE driving licence, code 95 and driver card

• Is residing in Belgium and has legal right to work in the country

• Has a good level of English

• Isn't afraid to start early in the morning and to tackle longer routes

• Has their own transport to the company (no public transport nearby)

Previous experience in frozen food transport, refrigerated transport or distribution transport is an advantage but not required.

 

!! IMPORTANT ELIGIBILITY REQUIREMENTS: please read carefully before applying !!

• You must already be living in Belgium

• You must already have a valid legal right to work in Belgium (EU citizenship or valid work permit)

Candidates who do not meet these requirements will not be considered for the position. We do not provide visa sponsorship, work permits, relocation support or immigration assistance.

jobs.employer_name: Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels NV
jobs.description:
To strengthen our Quality Team we are looking for a: QUALITY ENGINEER

Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is a subsidiary of Safran Aircraft Engines, based at Brussels Airport (Zaventem & Steenokkerzeel, Belgium), specialized in the inspection, maintenance and repair (MRO) of the advanced LEAP jet engines that power the latest generation of the Airbus A320NEO & Boeing B737MAX narrow body families. The company is a key player in the integrated CFM international MRO network. With more than 75 years of experience, and up to 20 international Part 145 certifications (EASA/ FAA/ CAAC/ …), Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is recognized as a worldwide center of expertise in the air transport industry. More than a 100 airlines, lessors, private aircraft operators and MRO partners have entrusted their engines to our company. We employ over 500 highly skilled, passionate and enthusiastic employees.

Your role:

• You prepare and submit certification files to national authorities and certification bodies.
• You analyze quality standards, norms, customer specifications, contracts and aviation regulations and adapt internal procedures or manuals, or draft new procedures.
• You organize and supervise external audits of customers, authorities and certification organisations and handle the findings.
• You are part of the validation process of suppliers and subcontractors and monitor the process regarding the quality of the delivered products and services.
• You support the owners of the processes in dealing with quality deviations/findings, using quality basic techniques.
• You propose actions to improve the efficiency of the business processes.
• You prepare presentations and provide training to colleagues on quality topics.
• You participate in multidisciplinary projects.
• You conduct internal quality audits, provide reporting of findings and follow up on corrective actions.
• You assist in the statistical analysis of data and its reporting.
• You manage Non-Conformities at the Quality Level:
• Report any non-compliance and/or non-application of quality rules to management.
• Record and monitor quality deviations identified in products and processes, in accordance with the company's quality system.
• Analyze and catalog quality deviations relating to products and processes in order to statistically determine areas for improvement within the company.
• Raise awareness and provide guidance to all staff regarding quality management to ensure product compliance and the effective operation of company processes.
• Provide methodological support to management and/or process owners when addressing quality deviations in their area (using QMS tools).
• Independently validate the root causes of quality deviations as defined by process owners.
• Independently verify the effectiveness of corrective and remedial actions resulting from quality deviations.

Your profile:

• You have a Bachelor's or Master's degree in a technical field, or equivalent through experience.
• You are fluent in Dutch, French and English.
• You are analytically and editorially minded.
• You are creative in finding solutions within the established framework.
• You can work independently and are committed to develop your knowledge through self-study and research.
• You are open minded, you work in a structured way and you can motivate people with regards to the quality and safety policy of the company.
• Additional qualifications that may help you in this role (but not a must have) include:
• Experience in quality and safety management in aviation
• Knowledge of standards and guidelines from national and international aviation authorities (EN9110, EASA part 145, etc)
• Knowledge of quality management systems
• Knowledge of aircraft engines, metrology
• Knowledge of process management
• Knowledge and ability to apply quality techniques and methodologies, such as problem solving techniques (8D, Ishikawa, flow charts, , ...), audit techniques.

Candidates must be legally authorized to work in Belgium, holding either an EU passport or a valid work & residence permit. Please note that we do not provide assistance with visa or permit applications.
